metadata.case_name: HO HOI YUEN v. TSANG HO LUN

plaintiff.occupation_before: sole proprietor of Man Kee (trading and maintenance of sewing machine)

source: he was diagnosed as suffering from sprain neck.
I take the view that the plaintiff was injured to his neck and shoulder due to the accident and was only required to take 4 weeks sick leave.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of cervical spine, unspecified

source: I take the view that the plaintiff was injured to his neck and shoulder due to the accident and was only required to take 4 weeks sick leave.
When the plaintiff was first examined by the doctor at the A&E department of QEH, he suffered only minor injury to his neck and shoulder.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified muscle, fascia or tendon at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: protrusion of lumbar discs with narrowing of the sciatica and resultant lower back pain
source: The MRI showed protrusion of his lumbar discs, narrowing of the sciatica and resultant lower back pain.
he had pre-existing cervical and lumbar spine degeneration prior to the accident
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

manifestations.description: limited range of movement of neck, shoulder and the lower back
unable to have sex with his girlfriend since the accident
dizziness at the time of the accident
no neurological deficit on physical examination

treatments_received: psychiatric treatment/consultation at Western Psychiatric Centre

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
